intro.name: The trial
intro.text: Teams compete with a tightly wrapped fiber-and-hide ball, trying to carry or pass it across a marked field without dangerous contact.

choices.label: Hold mixed teams and emphasize cooperation.

a1.text: A spectacular final pass wins the match at the last moment.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives food

a2.text: A disputed boundary call causes uproar until a neutral child reveals where the ball landed.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives food

a3.text: The favored team loses because its captain refuses to pass to anyone else.

b1.text: A shy villager scores after teammates deliberately make room for (shy.him/her).

b3.text: Two rivals discover they make an excellent team and end their feud.

p1.text: A judge from the other community praises the winning rival despite pressure from (judge.his/her) own supporters. The crowd slowly applauds.

p2.text: An accusation of favoritism forces the judges to disclose their criteria; the disputed result is upheld, reversed, or declared a tie.

p3.text: Competitors from both communities secretly practice together and publicly acknowledge each other when the results are announced.
